title: Northbeam TechWorks Settlement of a Job at the Desk
content:
A customer holding a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job may ask, at the desk, to settle what that job has billed them. The request is answered by taking a payment against that job for the figure the settlement comes to.

The figure the customer settles is worked out only after the write-off owed on the membership ground stands recorded against the job's charges. Until such a write-off stands recorded against the job's charges, the figure the customer settles is not worked out.

## What the payment does to the job

The payment stands on the job as its own entry and lowers the service charges outstanding on it by the amount received, so the customer can see the bill cleared down to what is left. A consumer profile settles the figure on the day it is worked out.

## Taking the payment

The payment is taken with `settle_service_bill_ea31a412`. It is a tool of the customer's own: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to settle the charges. It is not listed among the ordinary desk tools and is reached only once unlocked.

One call books one payment entry on that job for the amount the customer pays and lowers the job's outstanding service charges by it. The entry is dated the day the money is taken and is taken as a telephone entry.

## The four values the call carries

| Value | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `service_agreement_id` | an identifier: the reference number of the TechWorks work order or care agreement whose charges are being settled, as the agent hands it over before the call |
| `customer_id` | an identifier: the reference number of the paying customer's profile, as the agent hands it over before the call |
| `payment_amount` | the amount being paid, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed, always positive |
| `payment_method` | how the money is coming in, exactly one of the five values below |

| `payment_method` | When it is the way recorded |
| --- | --- |
| `card_on_file` | the card kept on the profile is charged |
| `store_credit` | a store credit balance is spent instead of money |
| `bank_transfer` | the customer sends the money from their bank |
| `in_store_cash` | the customer pays cash at a store counter |
| `business_invoice` | the amount is put on a business account's invoice to be settled on its terms |

## What the call returns

A one-line confirmation string naming the payment entry reference that was created, the job it was booked on, the amount received in USD to two decimal places, the way it was taken and the job's new outstanding service charges in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that entry reference in the reply is what shows the payment was recorded.

On success the job carries one more entry and a lower outstanding figure, and the customer has a payment reference to quote.
